issues.description: Customers report the app does not accept their correct password when trying to sign in.
issues.name: Password rejected during login

issues.description: Customers report being unable to log into their accounts and find the number of ads intrusive.
issues.name: Account access blocked and excessive ads

issues.description: A reviewer reacts angrily to Spotify appearing to ask for money like a donation, which reads as a billing-related complaint, though only one example was provided so the cluster cannot be confirmed.
issues.name: Users perceive app payment requests as begging

issues.description: After a recent update, free users can no longer pick specific songs, skip freely, or replay tracks without a Spotify Premium subscription, and they feel forced to pay for basic listening controls.
issues.name: Core playback features locked behind premium

issues.description: Customers feel the app lacks many songs and offers too little gospel music.
issues.name: Limited song and gospel catalog coverage

issues.description: Users report that lyrics do not appear for certain songs while appearing for others, making the feature inconsistent.
issues.name: Lyrics missing for some songs

issues.description: Users report that recommended tracks are being added to their own playlists, and some find the recommendations less relevant or less varied than before.
issues.name: Unwanted recommendations cluttering personal playlists

issues.description: Customers report that song downloads get stuck in the background and only resume after they reopen the app, which they find frustrating.
issues.name: Background downloads stall until app reopened

issues.description: Customers report that offline mode or downloaded content fails to work properly.
issues.name: Offline listening downloads not working

issues.description: Many reviews are short, vague complaints expressing dissatisfaction with the app or a recent update without naming a specific problem, along with some boycott and hostile remarks.
issues.name: Generic negative feedback about the app

issues.description: Premium users report the app cannot connect to the internet over Wi-Fi while mobile data works, and some songs play at poor audio quality.
issues.name: Playback fails on Wi-Fi but works on mobile data

issues.description: Customers report the app crashing on launch or freezing, leaving them unable to open or use it after the latest update.
issues.name: App crashes and freezes during playback

issues.description: Users report that songs do not play, including via Google Assistant with Spotify playlists, and the app gets stuck on the loading or logo screen.
issues.name: Playback fails and app stalls on loading

issues.description: Music playback halts partway through a song and does not resume from the stopping point, instead starting a different track.
issues.name: Playback stops unexpectedly mid-track

issues.description: Customers find the app flooded with ads, some of them loud, making it hard or frustrating to use without paying for premium.
issues.name: Excessive advertisements disrupting app usability

issues.description: Customers report that the app's interface and behavior frustrate them, with ads playing too often, audio controls like adjustment not working properly, and unexpected UX changes rolled out without clear ways to disable them.
issues.name: Usability problems and intrusive ads

issues.description: Customers find that playing a playlist shuffles or forces through unwanted songs, with limited skips, preventing them from simply listening to one chosen track.
issues.name: Playlist queue playback control frustration

issues.description: Customers say the latest update removed or hid basic player controls and changed the home screen, making the app harder to use.
issues.name: Confusing layout after recent app update
